scope: Freeze adversarial semantic decisions and required negative fixtures only.
commands: git status --short -- SEMANTIC_DECISIONS.md BRIEF.md DECISION_LOG.md build/task_reports/SPEC-01.json
confidentiality_evidence: All four external files were read strictly as source requirements and remained outside the repository.
SEMANTIC_DECISIONS.md contains normalized requirements and decisions, not source excerpts, source data, customer identifiers, source database names, or copied source-scale identifiers.
No external content was published or copied into a reusable asset.

P0-01.decision: Aircraft, source-event, audit-observation, and final-per-day assignment identities are distinct; complete same-day audit order drives spell analysis while final-per-day positive-width intervals drive date-visible as-of state.

P0-02.decision: Daily aircraft and schedule-knowledge intervals are half-open; schedule operating bounds are source-inclusive; the two sentinels and source end-event provenance remain distinct; same-day null observations create daily gaps only when date-visible.

P0-03.decision: Aircraft existence has an explicit lower bound and a provisionally exclusive end-of-life bound; daily dimension intervals are clipped, audit observations outside existence are rejected/quarantined, and before-event, unknown-gap, and after-EOL states are distinct.

P0-04.decision: Every attribute group has one semantic owner and temporal treatment; historically observed APU/dimension/weight values are versioned, while master-only copies are current-only and cannot be projected backward.

P0-05.decision: Only explicit complete snapshots drive presence/change inference; missing/incomplete dates cannot create changes, and post-gap facts are observed exactly at the later eligible endpoint without inventing an occurrence date inside the gap.

P0-06.decision: Schedule versions partition by schedule key, route parents permit concurrent open states, unchanged observations coalesce, and itinerary variants use a deterministic stable tie-break.

P0-07.decision: Key-preserving modifications and key presence additions/removals are exact; key-shift pairings remain medium unique candidates, low ambiguous groups, or unpaired, and never replace exact presence facts.

P0-08.decision: Knowledge and operating clocks are independent and explicitly parameterized; capacity requires both; local instances use local date/time plus arrival-day evidence, and UTC dates remain unresolved without explicit offsets or expanded timestamps.

P0-09.decision: Marketing and operating carrier roles are explicit; physical capacity excludes marketing-only codeshare copies and exposes unresolved physical services; cabin totals retain raw values and use explicit exclusive buckets/quality flags.

P0-10.decision: Passenger plans and actual legs stay separate; historical rows win typed-union overlaps; null canonical-key components create audited invalid observations or quarantine rather than identities; exact, heuristic, ambiguous, unmatched, and one-to-many fulfillment remain distinct.

P0-11.decision: Rotation uses validated same-local-day next-flight links, exact UTC non-backtracking comparison, actual airports/times, typed anomaly termination, and independent per-leg aircraft-history enrichment.

P0-12.decision: Code mappings are exact only at cardinality one; configuration loss is left-preserved with dimension-specific unresolved gaps; mixed-engine sets are explicitly incomplete and never fabricated.

P0-13.decision: Snowflake canonicalizes physical inputs while RAI owns reusable semantic/query logic; model sources are change-tracked physical tables; independent expected rows and package/standalone parity are hard gates.

P0-14.decision: Claims are functional and representative-shape only; timings require full environment/materialization context; UC1 remains an independently runnable truthful fallback.

P0-15.decision: The release agent uses a curated typed query catalog, asks for missing clock/carrier semantics, preserves confidence and plan/actual labels, and fails safely for invalid or unsupported questions.

adversarial_review_coverage.required_negative_fixture_categories: all covered and expanded into 22 fixture classes

findings: Audit observations and date-visible intervals needed separate ownership.
UTC instance dates were unsafe without offsets or expanded timestamps.
Null passenger composite components lacked a stable invalid/quarantine policy.
Rotation needed an exact temporal comparison and selected-day boundary.
Post-gap, configuration-dimension, de-duplication, and terminology details needed tightening.
rounds.resolution: All findings were incorporated into the artifact.

findings: Same-day null audit observations still needed qualification before opening a daily unknown interval.
Existence clipping needed to apply only to daily intervals, with outside-existence audit observations rejected/quarantined.
rounds.resolution: P0-02, P0-03, NF-A01, and HT-04 were corrected.
Reviewer found no remaining semantic contradiction, untestable P0 assertion, or uncovered adversarial category.

timings.timing_scope: Command wall times reported by the execution tools; prose authoring/review think time is not fabricated.

orchestrator_integration_required.action: Append the five provisional semantic decisions from SEMANTIC_DECISIONS.md to DECISION_LOG.md with evidence, independent-review history, confidence, affected tests, rollback, and status before treating the repository-level decision protocol as satisfied.
orchestrator_integration_required.reason: The SPEC-01 assignee's writable files explicitly excluded DECISION_LOG.md; the requirement was escalated to /root during execution.

unresolved_risks: The end-of-life boundary is provisionally exclusive until authoritative clarification; the frozen rollback test is documented.
Historically observed APU/dimension/weight fields are versioned while master-only copies are current-only; SPEC-02 must enumerate the exact reduced column set.

Physical operating capacity intentionally reports and excludes codeshare-only services that lack a stable physical-service representative, preventing false double counts at the cost of visible undercount risk.
The conservative key-shift candidate rule can miss non-overlapping operating-range amendments and reports that limitation rather than forcing a match.
UTC instance dates remain unresolved when the source offers only UTC TIME without offset/date-shift or an expanded timestamp.
These risks are explicit, tested, and non-blocking under the frozen release semantics.
